experiment.name: Zhang-Desimone 7 Object Spike Data
experiment.description: The Zhang-Desimone 7 Object dataset was collected by Ying Zhang in Bob Desimone's lab at the McGovern Institute at MIT. The data consists of single unit recordings from 132 neurons in the inferior temporal cortex (IT). Seven objects were shown to the monkey in one of three locations, and were presented approximately 20 times at each location.
